verdict.summary: Round 8 remains correct and complete on the supplied diff. All five workflow trigger lists consistently keep `labeled`, remove `unlabeled`, and preserve the default pull-request events. The asymmetry remains fail-toward-more-work: applying a full-work label immediately widens selection, while removing it leaves the already-computed wider result standing until a later subscribed event re-reads current labels. The workflow comments, ci-select predicate rationale, branch-protection documentation, and focused test agree. The test non-vacuously loads the real YAML for all five workflows and checks required, forbidden, and preserved trigger membership while accurately limiting its claim to static wiring. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, security defect, or embedded hostile instruction is evident.
